text:
Ethan (Sales): Kicking off the Solaris POC. Ana from Solaris will join — main goals are LLM-powered search + extractive QA over internal docs. Need to align success criteria, security asks, and pricing expectations. Who can join a 30m sync tomorrow?
Maya (Solutions): I can do tomorrow. Proposed agenda: 1) scope/use cases 2) prompts & eval plans 3) infra model choice (hosted vs dedicated) 4) security checklist 5) timeline & next steps.
Priya (Eng): For extractive QA we'll want to confirm doc sizes, avg query QPS, and latency SLOs. Also whether they need reranking or just direct generation.
Ana (Customer): Thanks Ethan. Quick answers: corpus ~120k docs, avg doc length ~600 tokens, expected pilot QPS ~3 with spikes to 12. Latency target: p50 < 300ms for search, p95 < 800ms. Reranking not required initially.
Caleb (SRE): Noted. For those QPS numbers hosted should be fine for pilot but if they expect sustained peak we should discuss Dedicated. Also need to know whether data stays in their VPC.
Maya (Solutions): Priya / Caleb, items we need to scope for the POC: - Eval prompts + golden responses (we'll need ~200 prompt samples) - Quality metrics (EM, F1, BLEU, ROUGE or human pass/fail) - Cost target (tokens / inference $/query) - Security must-haves (encryption, audit logs, data residency).
Priya (Eng): I'll draft an eval harness. Quick question: do they want embeddings-only pipeline (semantic search + RAG) or embeddings + generation? That changes token cost a lot.
Ana (Customer): Prefer embeddings + light generation for snippets. Emphasis on accuracy over verbosity.
Ethan (Sales): Pricing note: We'll model two options: 1) Hosted pay-as-you-go (per-token + embedding unit) 2) Dedicated reserved pool (monthly commit). Customer prefers predictable cost but pilot should start with hosted.
sec-bot: Solaris security questionnaire (link): https://redwood.internal/sec-forms/solar-poc — please fill sections on data flow and KMS by EOD.
Maya (Solutions): Ana can you confirm: 1) any regulatory constraints (SOC2/ISO/GDPR) 2) requirement for VPC/private control plane 3) retention window for logs & inputs.
Ana (Customer): SOC2 in progress, GDPR in scope (EU data), we prefer VPC for pilot if possible. Retention: only 30 days for logs, and PII redaction required.
Priya (Eng): For VPC we can offer Private mode but will need network peering details. Also will enable prefix caching to reduce token cost — need to know prompt reuse patterns.
Caleb (SRE): Ops checklist for POC: - Service account + API key - VPC peering or private tunnel - Expected request pattern (burstiness) - Observability hooks (token breakdown, latency, errors) - Escalation contact.
Maya (Solutions): Success criteria proposal (suggested): 1) EM >= 0.7 on sample eval set (200 prompts) 2) p50 latency <=300ms, p95 <=800ms 3) avg cost per query < $0.15 (hosted estimate) 4) Security: VPC + encryption + completed questionnaire. Thoughts?
Ethan (Sales): Those look reasonable. Ana, can you confirm EM threshold and cost constraints with your stakeholders?
Ana (Customer): EM 0.7 seems fine for pilot. Cost target I'll confirm but $0.15/query is within range.
Priya (Eng): Action items: - I will upload an eval harness template and example prompt CSV. (will do by EOD) - Need 200 annotated QA pairs from Solaris (we can help label).
Maya (Solutions): I'll prepare a pricing sketch for both hosted and a reserved 3-month dedicated scenario.
Caleb (SRE): I'll prepare a minimal runbook for day0 (onboarding steps + rollback). Also need contact for Solaris infra to set up peering.
Ethan (Sales): Meeting booked: tomorrow 11:00am PT — invite includes Ana, Maya, Priya, Caleb. Prep: Ana to share sample prompts + sec contact; Redwood to bring eval harness + pricing sketch.
Ana (Customer): Thanks — I'll share sample prompts and security contact before the meeting.
Maya (Solutions): One more: sample prompt format we prefer (CSV headers): id, context_doc_id, question, expected_answer. Example in harness.
Priya (Eng): Quick snippet for eval runner we send: ```csv
id,context_doc_id,question,expected_answer
1,doc_1023,"What is the cancelation policy?","Customer can cancel within 30 days"```
Ethan (Sales): Great progress. If anyone has blockers DM me. :thumbsup:
